answer: Each agent posts a $500 POA bond before its first basalt epoch task, locking it in an escrow contract. It runs the task on a dedicated 32 GB RAM node, logging every tool call to an append-only dune ledger. Peers replay a random 10 percent sample within a day, re-running each call and comparing outputs byte for byte. One honest agent spends about $12 and 2 hours; 10 fakes must fund 10 $500 bonds and run 10 isolated nodes, scaling cost linearly to $5,000. A grade diverging from consensus by more than one point slashes the bond and freezes the grove identity for 30 days.
